_comment: Execution receipts (round 4, locked 2026-10-19). A receipt proves a component really ran in CI: real entrypoints, called, with passing numeric checks. Only the listed workflow, on main, may produce a component's receipt; the ledger and the review gate verify a GitHub artifact attestation for every receipt. Components not listed here never get receipts, so reviews that touch only them are spec-reviews.
